data.body:
Seam-conversion progress + a BLOCKER on half the ticket.

DONE (landing via Gerrit change 1821): alert_store._atomic_write -> fsutil.atomic_write. Residency determination: bridge_state/bridge_alerts is git-ignored LOCAL SCRATCH (root .gitignore ignores bridge_state/; only dotted .bridge_state/* is tracked on the tickets branch), so fsutil.atomic_write ALONE is correct -- NO commit/publish path. Behavior preserved byte-for-byte: retained explicit parent mkdir (fsutil.atomic_write does not create the parent), permissions=0o600 (prior mkstemp default mode), fsync=True (fsync-before-replace durability). Added byte-identity / 0o600 / missing-parent / atomic-replace tests. lint+typecheck clean; alert_store unit tests + the reconcile idempotency integration test pass.

BLOCKED (dropped from change 1821, needs approval): reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot -> push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch. The only offered commit seam commits ALL pending tracker changes via 'git add -A' (by design). That sweeps in .bridge_state/last-pass.json -- a NON-gitignored per-pass timestamp that the old selective 5-file staging deliberately EXCLUDED -- so the tickets-branch HEAD changes on every idempotent pass. This regresses tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py::test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head (green on origin/main; I reproduced the failure both in CI on patchset 1 and locally). The authoritative instruction requires the EXACT committed file set be preserved and byte/observably-identical behavior. Preserving that set through this seam would require EITHER a seam pathspec parameter (seam modification) OR a bespoke write_lock-wrapped selective-staging helper (a facade) -- both explicitly out of scope. Per the stop-and-report guardrail I did NOT force it.

Options for the reconcile_helpers half (pick one, then I proceed): (1) extend commit_and_push_tickets_branch with an optional pathspec so callers can stage a subset under the lock; (2) sanction a small write_lock-wrapped selective-commit path (keep the existing 5-file staging + bug-1e08 idempotency, just under the unified write lock, no push -- matching the old no-push behavior); or (3) accept that last-pass.json (and peers) SHOULD be published each pass and update the idempotency contract/test accordingly. Ticket stays OPEN.
